commands.name: video
commands.title: Video
commands.subtitle: Download video with customizable parameters
commands.description: Download video with yt-dlp parameters. Keys: -f format, -q quality, -yt yt-dlp params, -ff ffmpeg params

arguments.name: query
arguments.placeholder: Paste URL and optional keys: -q 1080 -f mp4 -yt bv+ba/best -ff '-c:v copy -c:a aac'

commands.name: audio
commands.title: Audio
commands.subtitle: Download audio with customizable parameters
commands.description: Download audio with format and ffmpeg options. Keys: -f format, -ff ffmpeg params

arguments.name: query
arguments.placeholder: Paste URL and optional keys: -f mp3 -ff '-c:a libmp3lame'

commands.name: video-best
commands.title: Video Best
commands.subtitle: Download video in best quality
commands.description: Download video in best possible quality without re-encoding

arguments.placeholder: Paste URL to download video in best possible quality without re-encoding

commands.name: audio-best

commands.subtitle: Download audio in best quality and convert to WAV
